name: oz-policy-builder
description: OZ Policy Builder - toolkit for OpenZeppelin smart-account policies on Stellar: record a transaction, synthesise the minimal policy that permits exactly that flow, verify it, and return an unsigned install transaction.

scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/policy-synth/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/policy-builder-cli/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/policy-builder-mcp/tsconfig.json
